decisions.situation: Maverick paddles out and spots a big wave building faster than expected.

options.text: Lean into it and adjust his stance

decisions.situation: Another surfer cuts across Maverick's path without warning.

options.text: Ease off and let them pass first

results.title: Steady Sailor
results.message: Maverick trusted caution over speed today. Careful choices keep you steady when it counts.
